description_en: Queries the status of an IoT card on the carrier side through intelligent diagnostics
description_zh: 智能诊断-查询卡在运营商侧状态
name: GetCardRealStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can find the ICCID on the IoT card itself or on the Card Management page of the IoT SIM Service console
parameters.help_zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在物联网SIM服务控制台的卡管理页面查看ICCID
parameters.name: iccid

parameters.help_en: The MSISDN of the IoT card
parameters.name: msisdn

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier for polling query results
parameters.help_zh: 轮询查询结果的唯一标识
parameters.name: serial_no

Code.description_en:
The return code of the operation.

200: The call was successful. Other values: An error occurred. For more information, see error codes
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。

200：表示成功。 其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误码

Gprs.description_en:
The network service status.

true: Enabled.

false: Disabled
Gprs.description_zh:
网络服务状态。

true：开通。

false：关闭

Iccid.description_en: The ICCID of the card. If the requested ICCID is the primary card of a multi-network card, the ICCID of the secondary card is returned
Iccid.description_zh: 卡的ICCID，当请求ICCID为多网卡主卡时，此处返回子卡ICCID

Online.description_en:
The online status.

true: Online.

false: Offline
Online.description_zh:
在线状态。

true：在线。

false：不在线

SerialNo.description_en:
The unique identifier for polling query results.

Note:

Because the carrier capability of this operation is limited and query results take time, use this operation with the polling mechanism.

After the first request, if Status is not successful, this value is returned in the response parameters. Use this value to poll for results
SerialNo.description_zh:
轮询查询结果的唯一标识。

说明：

1、因该接口运营商能力较弱，查询结果需时，故结合轮询能力使用。

2、在首次请求后，如Status未成功，则返回参数中会带此数据，再用此数据进行结果轮询

Status.description_en:
The status of the query result. Valid values: 

SUCCESS: The query was successful.

FAILURE: The query failed.

PROCESSING: The query is being processed
Status.description_zh:
查询结果状态： 

SUCCESS：成功

FAILURE：失败

PROCESSING：处理中

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

LocalizedMessage.description_en: The error message displayed in the language that corresponds to the current region
LocalizedMessage.description_zh: 根据当前所在地展示对应语言的错误提示

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful. false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。 false：调用失败
